summary: Iteration 223 — Backend-only tests for the new GET /api/people-ops/time-clock/aggregate-daily endpoint. All 6 new tests pass. Regression suite test_ot_deprecation_iter222.py still 9/9.
critical_code_review_comments: aggregate-daily correctly filters clock_out != None so open shifts are excluded.
break_min computed from gaps between consecutive rows within same work_date; sorts by clock_in ascending — correct.

Access control uses check_people_ops_access(user, 'view'); scoped to caller company_id. However, note: any admin/hr/manager with people_ops view permission can query ANY employee_id within their own company — no explicit self-scope for non-admins reaching this endpoint. This matches the endpoint intent (Weekly Timesheet prefill for admins) but if a regular employee ever hits it, they'd see any teammate's data if the check_people_ops_access permits 'view'. Recommend confirming that non-admins get 403 here (self-scoping happens inside check_people_ops_access via required role level).
